name: Looks Health Services Limited
about: Looks Health Services Limited provides dental, and cosmetic and non-cosmetic treatment services in India. The company offers skin treatment, hair transplant, laser transplant, and cosmetic surgery services. It is also involved in the sale of supporting medicine. The company was formerly known as Monarch Health Services Limited and changed its name to Looks Health Services Limited in March 2013. Looks The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
